name: porchlight
description: Offline-first neighbourhood emergency network. When the grid goes dark, the porch lights stay on.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol apps/node apps/sim && npm run typecheck -w @porchlight/city
scripts.sim:ci: tsx apps/sim/src/run.ts nodes=30 loss=0.3 cycles=50 assert && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('reports/sim-latest.json','apps/city/public/sim-report.json')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:firmware && npm run sim:ci
